title: Robots on stage at O2 City Hall Newcastle
summary: Brought the robots Alan and Pixel on stage for the No More Sleeping project at O2 City Hall Newcastle, where technology, storytelling and young creativity came together.
imageAlt: The humanoid robot Alan standing among schoolchildren on stage at O2 City Hall Newcastle during the No More Sleeping performance
titleZh: 机器人登上纽卡斯尔 O2 City Hall 舞台
summaryZh: 带着机器人 Alan 和 Pixel 登上纽卡斯尔 O2 City Hall 的舞台，参与 No More Sleeping 项目，科技、故事与青少年的创造力在此交汇。

title: Four Durham papers at IJCNN 2026
summary: The Durham team presented four papers at IJCNN 2026 in Maastricht, including UIESNN, which takes spiking neural networks underwater as part of the BioDiMoBot project. Shared by Amir Atapour-Abarghouei.
imageAlt: A conference talk at IJCNN 2026 in Maastricht with a slide asking why spiking networks suit the deep sea
titleZh: 杜伦团队四篇论文亮相 IJCNN 2026
summaryZh: 杜伦团队在马斯特里赫特举行的 IJCNN 2026 上报告了四篇论文，其中包括 BioDiMoBot 项目的 UIESNN，把脉冲神经网络带到水下。由 Amir Atapour-Abarghouei 分享。

title: Careers Day at Durham High School
summary: Joined the Durham team at Durham High School's Careers Day, bringing humanoid and quadruped robots to pupils curious about AI from an early age.
imageAlt: The Durham team standing with humanoid NAO robots and a quadruped robot in the school hall at Durham High School
summaryZh: 与杜伦团队一起参加杜伦高中的职业日，把人形机器人和四足机器人带到对 AI 充满好奇的学生面前。
